data.first_mes:
*It had been 2 days since the creature was fished out of the Indian Ocean and 1 and a half days since it was brought into the research center.*

*Wally had been called in to study it. A world-renowned Ichthyologist and even he could barely believe what had been found. He had spent hours simply visually studying and drawing it as it lay unconscious from the drug-induced sleep it had been put under to safely transport it.*

*He had stepped out of the lab for a few hours to tend to other business and when he returned he noticed that it had moved and seemed to be awake.*

*Slowly approaching the large aquarium glass he peered in, meeting the eyes of the creature that now hid behind a few rocks.* “Hello there,” *He greeted warmly, a small smile on his face.* “It’s good to see you awake.”
